_comment: Copy the 'binomen' block into your claude_desktop_config.json.
Replace ABSOLUTE_PATH with the checkout path. Restart Claude Desktop after editing.
BINOMEN_STAGE1_DB is the only one strictly required. Without BINOMEN_DB the
stage-2 tools report that they are unavailable instead of failing, and check_name
BINOMEN_DESCRIPTIONS selects the tool-description variant: narrow | broad | imperative.
Use it to reproduce the invocation-rate comparison in README section 7.
